_note: First slice: mid-1870s to mid-1880s drives and railheads. Run length is days; about 4400 days from 1874 reaches early 1886; the first year is warm-up while towns settle toward their trade income.

shocks.name: Black Hills gold rush
shocks.cause: Custer's 1874 expedition confirmed gold; the 1876 rush ignored the Fort Laramie treaty

shocks.name: Hard winter
shocks.cause: overstocked northern range and a severe winter (the 1886-87 die-out)
